scope: One Piece Card Game: Asia English (asia-en) and Traditional Chinese (asia-tc) official card lists vs CardScope DB, read-only. Text facts only, no images downloaded.
note: The packet named asia-tw.onepiece-cardgame.com; the Traditional Chinese Asia site (also the one providers/catalog-sync.mjs uses) is asia-tc.onepiece-cardgame.com.

officialListFormat.request: GET /cardlist/?search=true&series=<id>; a whole series is on one HTML page (client-side paging); result count in div.countCol; each card is <dl class="modalCol" id="<provider id>"> with infoCol = number | rarity | type, cardName, getInfo (card sets). Unchanged vs the format the sync parses.

missingSeries.cause: parseOnePieceSeries() in providers/catalog-sync.mjs keeps only dropdown options whose label has a bracketed set code ([OP-13] or 【OP-18】); these three have none, so they are never requested. All 59 coded series exist in the DB for both regions (OP-01..17, EB-01..04, PRB-01..02, ST-01..36). OP-18 and EB-05 are not in the official card-list dropdown yet (HANDOFF 61).

missingCards.summary: Every official card absent from the DB (632 per site) appears only on the three code-less series pages (51+192+389 = 632, no overlap with coded pages). Of the 632, 493 are extra art / promo printings of card numbers the DB already has and 139 are 105 promo numbers (P-xxx) that the DB does not have at all.
missingCards.extraInDb: none: every DB ASIA/TW printing exists on the official list (JP seed excluded)

countMismatches.headline: Official page count vs DB printings per series differs for 106 of 118 coded series rows (both regions). All are explained by grouping; under the DB rule (printings grouped by card-number prefix, cards present on coded pages) 0 series differ and TW equals ASIA for all 59.
causes: Official pages list a reprint under every product that contains it: PRB-01 page 319 cards but only 2 carry the PRB01 prefix; ST-15..ST-36 deck pages show 15 = 5 own + 10 reprints. The DB files each printing under the set code in its card number (OP01-xxx -> OP-01) and keeps one printing per provider id.
DB can exceed the page count: OP-01 page 154, DB 205, because alt-art / re-release printings of OP01 numbers are listed on other coded pages (PRB-01, PRB-02, EB-xx, STs) and are filed under OP-01.
Prefix P- (promo numbers) maps to no series: 60 DB cards / 60 TW printings / 59 ASIA printings have series_id NULL.
Cards that exist only on the code-less pages are not in the DB (see missingCards); for example OP-01 has 39 more official printings on those pages.

variant.note: Variant suffix (_p = parallel, _r = reprint art) and the "(Parallel)" name suffix match official for every card present; image filename equals provider id for all printings.

observations: Rarity is stored raw per source: ASIA printings carry "SP CARD", TW printings and the shared card row carry "SP卡", so the card row shows a Chinese rarity for 132 cards in English views. A normalisation item, not an error.
tcg_cards.name_en for P-029_r2 is null: the card exists only on the TW list.

facts: tcg_cards holds one row per card art (provider id such as OP17-001_p1) shared by both sites; the sync writes it once with series_id = the ASIA series (providers/catalog-sync.mjs twCardRows uses seriesByCode, the English series map).

The TW copy is a tcg_printings row (source onepiece-official-tw, region TW, series_id = the TW series): 4,283 TW printings, 4,223 in the 59 TW series (60 promo P- NULL), identical per series to the ASIA side.
Production check: /api/cards?game=onepiece&series=onepiece-official-tw-op-17&region=TW returns OP17-001 with a TW printing, so TW series browsing works through printings.
Side effect: ASIA series carry metadata.cardsCount (59/59), TW series do not (0/59); a UI showing the series count from that field has nothing for TW.

recommendations.action: Sync the three code-less series (Promotion card, Limited Product Card, Family Deck Set) for both regions as series/products, and attach their printings (493 art variants of existing numbers + 105 new P- numbers per site). Needs: parseOnePieceSeries to accept options without a code (use a fixed code like P / LIM / FAM and a flag), series_id for P- numbers, same politeness. Value: promo and tournament-prize cards are among the most searched and traded.
Write metadata.cardsCount for the 59 TW series (same as ASIA) so TW series tiles show counts.
Give the 60 existing P- cards a promo series once rank 1 exists.
Decide on the JP seed row (remove or keep); its image is from a third-party host.
Optional: normalise the 8 full-width-space TW names and the SP卡 / SP CARD rarity label.
Re-run this audit after OP-18 / EB-05 enter the official card list.
